datePolicy: All source access dates are original November 7, 2026 reads, not copy-authoring refreshes. School publication days remain unknown where unrecorded. Preserve five AY2026/27 baselines, Taylor calendar-2027 fees and exact published KL term, outdated/excluded fee gates and KDU policy dates. No 2027/28 invoice or 2028 progression invented.

familyProfile.placement: Exact birth dates and whether stated ages are current or entry ages unresolved; no exact ages invented.

calendarPlanningClarification: Student Pass arrangements: count back at least three months from the actual intended first day. For August entry, plan to begin by May; for September entry, by June. Derived count-back guidance, not an official deadline or government processing guarantee. Employer/dependent-pass and permitted-study requirements remain individual. No new external research or confirmed first day implied.
languageVerificationLimit: Sri Bestari publications support English curriculum and Mandarin subjects, but an explicit whole-school English-medium statement was not separately verified. Public prose asks the school to confirm each target year group's subject teaching languages. No extra English programme remains the published limitation; no bilingual or Mandarin-medium upgrade implied.
